data.body: **[P1] Keep fork PRs off the CodeBuild account runner.** This workflow runs for every `pull_request`, checks out PR-controlled code, and executes tests, build hooks, and shell scripts. Using this runner therefore lets untrusted fork code access any AWS service-role credentials or account resources exposed to the CodeBuild environment. Keep pull-request validation on `ubuntu-latest` and run a separate CodeBuild job only for trusted push/manual events; enforce the trusted-ref restriction in the CodeBuild webhook or IAM boundary so a PR cannot bypass it by editing the workflow.
